description: This file provides functions to create and manage an unsafe sandbox environment, including creating sandbox bridges, sandbox contexts, and a harness for testing sandbox mounting behavior.

methods.name: createUnsafeMountedBridge
methods.description: Creates a sandbox filesystem bridge that maps /agent paths to host paths, resolving paths based on provided parameters.

methods.name: createUnsafeMountedSandbox
methods.description: Creates a sandbox context with an unsafe filesystem bridge, configured with specified root directories.

methods.name: withUnsafeMountedSandboxHarness
methods.description: Sets up a temporary sandbox environment, runs a provided async function with the sandbox context, and cleans up afterward.
